entities.summary: Tim Skold (b. 1966-12-14, Skövde) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Skövde and Sweden. Known in the fields of sweden, composers & musicians, europe.
